==Description==
'''Honey Valley''' is a private server-exclusive [[Maps|map]].

==Design & Path==
'''Honey Valley''' has three areas, with them being separated by a river of honey. They are connected by various bridges. A honey waterfall is created by a large dark brown pot. There are many bee boxes and brown pots on the map, as well as giant flowers of various colors, some of which serve as cliff space. There is also a wooden house located in a forest.

The path starts at an open beehive and ends at a tree. It consists of three loops, two of which are quite close to the enemy spawn and one being close to the exit. The path also goes over the honey river with a bridge.

{{Map:Honey Valley}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Very Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*The beginning of the map is a great spot for towers, as enemies have to do two loops to progress in the map.
**Towers with small range such as the [[Warden]], [[Sledger]] or the [[Gladiator]] will be quite useful in these spots.
**While these loops could be very useful for the [[Ace Pilot]], it is not possible to place ground towers there, only cliff towers on the flowers.
*As the path on this map is quite compact, high range towers like the [[Turret]], [[Hunter]] or [[Ranger]] can easily cover most of the map.
**This makes cliff towers useful here due to their high range, though do note that the flowers only allow a small amount of cliff towers to be placed on them, making cliff space limited here.
**The [[DJ Booth]] can be helpful as it can allow them to cover all of the map.
***Cliff towers at later Levels can cover most of the map without the help from [[DJ Booth]].
